ReUceh8Ia8AEQUXN5kWI.description:
A kssar is a hairy, long-limbed, bat-like humanoid that skulks in the dark places of the earth. Their tiny black eyes are perpetually bulged as if in surprise, and their oversized ears allow them to track prey from great distances underground. The leathery membranes on their arms are not strong enough to allow for flight, but they do help propel the greedy creatures in pursuits.
While legend holds that the kssar once had a grand society in the deep caverns, today the creatures are too selfish and short-sighted to maintain social groups for long. A kssar values treasure more than home or stability, and will gladly kill and steal from their companions before fleeing far away. Occasionally, though, a more willful monster in need of minions can forcibly wrangle a handful of kssar for a longer-term undertaking with promises of great plunder.
